summary: A floating popup menu or box that appears anchored to a button, like a dropdown menu.
description: A XUL popup panel used for menus, dropdowns, and arrow-anchored callouts. No JSDoc; wraps the native XULPopupElement and adds arrow-panel defaulting, animation lifecycle, and focus-restore behavior on top of it.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The sole gate for arrow-panel behavior: "arrow" enables default flip/side/position/consumeoutsideclicks values, side auto-recalculation, and the panelopen/animate lifecycle. Any other value is a plain popup.

attributes.name: flip
attributes.description: Defaulted to "both" for arrow panels if unset; actual flip behavior is implemented natively by XULPopupElement, not in this file.

attributes.name: side
attributes.description: Defaulted to "top" for arrow panels; also recomputed dynamically to left/right/top/bottom by _setSideAttribute() on popuppositioned, based on alignmentPosition and text direction.

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Defaulted to "bottomleft topleft" for arrow panels; positioning itself is implemented natively.

attributes.name: consumeoutsideclicks
attributes.description: Defaulted to "false" for arrow panels (arrow panels do NOT consume outside clicks by default).

attributes.name: neverhidden
attributes.description: When present, the shadow-root content slot is never forced to display:none on hide.

attributes.name: no-open-on-anchor
attributes.description: When present, skips toggling the open attribute on the anchor's root (toolbarbutton or .anchor-root) while the panel is shown.

attributes.name: animate
attributes.description: Opt out of open/close animation by setting to "false"; the component itself also writes "open"/"cancel" values as internal transition state.

attributes.name: norestorefocus
attributes.description: When set to "true", focus is not restored to the pre-open element after the panel closes.

attributes.name: panelopen
attributes.description: Read-only, state-reflecting: set true on popupshown and removed on popuphidden (arrow panels only). Consumers may select on it in CSS but should not set it.

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.description: Overridden getter/setter: setting hidden=false (or removing the attribute) lazily initializes the shadow DOM via ensureInitialized().

attributes.name: animating
attributes.description: Internal-only transition lock, set true on popupshowing and removed on popupshown; not consumer-facing config.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: Default shadow-DOM slot with part="content"; panel children render here.

events.name: AlertActive
events.description: Legacy Events-type event dispatched unconditionally from on_popupshown when event.target == this, for accessibility APIs.

cssParts.name: content
cssParts.description: The default content slot (<html:slot part="content"/>), also returned by the panelContent getter.
